# AI Vision — AI screenshot assistant for Chrome

> AI Vision is a free Chrome extension for selecting a screenshot, asking Gemini to explain it, and asking a follow-up question. It also extracts text from images, summarizes supported webpages, and compares supported tabs.

## Official links

- Product website: https://stiwarilbj.github.io/AI_Vision/
- Chrome Web Store listing (public v2.5): https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ai-vision-gemini-screensh/ghmmlbclopoakmjjbkkmoefjldgjimgk
- Public source: https://github.com/stiwarilbj/AI_Vision
- Privacy notice: https://stiwarilbj.github.io/AI_Vision/privacy.html

- Get a Gemini API key for AI Vision: https://stiwarilbj.github.io/AI_Vision/guides/get-gemini-api-key.html

## Product facts

- Supported browser: desktop Google Chrome on supported webpages.
- Main workflow: choose Screenshot, select an area, explain the image, and ask a follow-up.
- Other contexts: This page and Compare tabs; Browser tasks are optional and approval-gated.
- Gemini requirement: users bring their own API key from Google AI Studio and save it in the extension Settings.
- Cost and limits: the extension is free to install; Google controls Gemini model access, quotas, rate limits, and billing.
- Data handling: the key and preferences stay in local Chrome extension storage. A requested question and the necessary screenshot or page context go directly to Google’s Gemini API. AI Vision has no developer proxy, advertising, or analytics service.
- Accuracy: Gemini explanations and AI-assisted text extraction can be wrong. Check important names, numbers, dates, and codes against the source.

## Version note

Current version: 2.8 GitHub-build preview; the public Chrome Web Store listing currently shows version 2.5. Website screenshots labeled “v2.8 preview” describe the GitHub build and may contain controls that are not yet in the Store listing.
